Status Move waits rand(180)+180 ticks, then Rotate for 90 ticks at +-0.07 rad/tick (random sign) and snaps rotate.z back to 0. Captures a fighter when |dx|<280 and |dy|<280 (fighter tarucann_wait==0, not already in TaruCann, no other fighter inside).
